order_book: Given our existing resources and execution bandwidth, we believe we are positioned to handle additional orders of up to INR500 crores alongside our current order book.

So if you just consider the current order book, we will be able to reduce it quite drastically in the coming few months because the erection portion Jay Bee Laminations Limited H2 & FY26 Post Earnings Conference Call May
guidance: We are confident of completing the work on time while ensuring the receivables are normalized in the next 3, 4 months.
We expect revenue booking of about INR100 crores in the existing orders in FY27 and the remaining amount in FY28.
capex: With an installed capacity of close to 24,000 metric tonnes per annum, we are currently operating at a monthly capacity utilization of about 65%, with the most hope for ramping up in power transformer cores.
We do not have major capacity expansion plans in FY27 as our focus will be on improving utilization across capacities.
risks: As a disclaimer, I would like to inform all of you that this call may contain forward-looking statements which may involve risk and uncertainties.
While the entire year remained more challenging than anticipated, we laid the foundation for multiple long-term growth drivers for the company.
focus: Overall, our cash conversion cycle went down to less than 70 days in FY26 compared to 116 days in FY25, despite entering and rapidly scaling a new business line.
We are targeting INR20 crores to INR30 crores in sales from this division in FY27, supported by developmental or export orders in hand and encouraging momentum in the domestic market.
Overall, our objective for FY27 is to maintain a similar volume growth trajectory while focusing on margin improvement.
